meta.title: Veritas Tasks — tasks that glow
meta.description: A planner where tasks become stars, projects become planets and shared goals with friends become constellations. Works offline, on phone and desktop.

design.title: Design system «Event Horizon»
design.lead: Tokens, components and interface rules on one page. The black hole is “now”; the interface around it is a strict instrument with no light of its own. Visible in development only.

tokens.lead: The background is near black, text is warm starlight. Three physical colours: the amber of the accretion disk, Doppler blue, and red for danger only. Contrast is measured on surface-1.
tokens.swatches: Tag and project colours: the star spectrum

typeSamples.body: Tasks, habits and projects orbit around “now”. Every action answers instantly, even offline.
typeSamples.bulgarian: Всяка задача е звезда. Подреди своето небе и ѝ дай светлина.
typeSamples.pangram: Sphinx of black quartz, judge my vow.
typeSamples.label: Today 18:00

fontCompare.lead: Headings: a strict grotesque with full Cyrillic, including the Bulgarian forms (д, л, ж and ѝ change shape in Bulgarian text). Body text is Onest; numbers and labels are monospaced.

motionSamples.lead: Short and exact, no springy overshoot. Long moves belong to the cinematic scenes.

brand.lead: Three directions on “truth and a black hole”. Every mark is lines of light, no fills, no gradients; small sizes are checked down to 16 px.
brand.lensText: Two lines of light bend around a dark point, the way mass bends light. The short left and long right arms read as a check mark: done.
brand.horizonText: The shadow, the photon ring and the disk in three lines. The far side of the disk is lensed over the shadow; the left side is brighter (Doppler).
brand.eclipseText: A dark disk and a thin crescent of light on its edge. The crescent runs into the long stroke of a check: truth shows at the edge.

grid.lead: A 4 px step with an 8 px rhythm. Radii from 0 to 8 px; circles only for things that are round: the horizon checkbox, avatars, status dots.

depth.lead: Depth comes only from background levels and 1 px lines. The higher the layer, the lighter the surface.
depth.noShadows: No shadows, glow, glass or blur. Dialogs sit on 78 % black, not blurred.

icons.lead: Lucide, 16 px, 1.5 stroke. Icons get colour only when it means something.

background.lead: The working background is rare, still stars on near black. No nebulae, no moving wallpapers.
background.stars: About one star per 20,000 px², 0.35–1.1 px, from warm white to blue. On a computer with a mouse, stars near the pointer bend like light around a mass: a main image and a faint second one. Move the pointer across the page.
background.lensHint: Only on computers with a mouse.

bans.lead: None of this exists in the interface. Light and bloom live only inside the 3D scenes, and only from real sources.
bans.test: The design-rules test checks the source for every item: if it fails, the screen is not done.

violet.instead: Amber, blue and red, each only for its meaning

radius.instead: 0–8 px; circles only for round things

template.no: Three cards with an icon in a circle, an empty hero, centred paragraphs, stock phrases
template.instead: A live piece of the product, left-aligned text, concrete words
